steps.prompt: What makes you change your mind about something: facts, stories, or someone answering your doubts?

cards.title: Five paragraphs that persuade
cards.body: Introduction (hook, background, thesis) → body 1 → body 2 → counterclaim and rebuttal → conclusion. Transitions link them: First, In addition, Some people argue, In the end.

cards.title: The essay checklist
cards.body: The checklist lists everything a strong essay needs. Items marked “checked for you” tick themselves as you write; tick the others once you have checked them. Edit until every item is done.

cards.title: Draft, then edit
cards.body: Write the whole draft first, then edit: fix the !s on the essay map, then work down the checklist. Read it aloud last.

prompts: Which checklist item took the most work?
What is the strongest sentence in your essay?
